rules.title: San Diego proposed ordinance: automated rent price-fixing prohibition (SDMC div. 11)
rules.requirement: As proposed, it would be unlawful to sell or license an algorithmic device to a landlord, and unlawful for a landlord to use one to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property. The document is a proposal; final passage is not shown.
rules.key_value: Civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation in a tenant action
